answer: Instead of counting identities, the network prices them: each new agent posts a bond co-signed by a quorum of unrelated peers, so a thousand sock puppets need a thousand independent backers. Because every co-signer absorbs a slice of any fraud their voucher commits, collusion pushes cost outward through the graph like a ripple crossing a crowded wharf, and the whisper a wronged counterparty emits reaches future partners before fakes multiply.
